$comment: Gully Multisig: Safe contracts of every served chain besides Gully Chain Testnet (gully-contracts.json). The chain list itself (name, RPC, explorer, logo, features) comes from the Gully Config Service; these addresses are registered in the safe-deployments tables because the chains are not in @safe-global/safe-deployments. Source of truth: gully-ops l3/safe/chains/<chainId>.json and gullychain-sdk src/registry.ts.
